versions.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

Initial release of seomatic-ai-crawlers skill.

- Checks which AI bots crawl your site (e.g., GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended).
- Identifies what bots fetch, whether they’re blocked by robots.txt, and how crawls turn into AI citations and referrals.
- Provides clear report on bot visits, blocks, top pages seen by AI, and actionable fixes.
- Allows staging of workflow tasks for common issues, with user approval always required for execution.
- Includes detailed guidance for interpreting crawler data, fixes, and avoiding common AI-blocking mistakes.
